items.question: Under the UAE federal government work patterns, which article of the Executive Regulations of the Human Resources Law in the Federal Government outlines the approved types of work in federal entities?
items.gold: Article 9 of the Executive Regulations of the Human Resources Law in the Federal Government.
items.fact: Article 9 lists approved federal work types in Executive Regulations

items.question: In the UAE federal government work patterns, when does the contract of an employee on temporary work end?
items.gold: The contract ends upon completion of the specific assignment the employee works on.
items.fact: Temporary federal work contract ends when assignment is completed
